creator: nocturne
statement: To open the first boss (Encroaching Forest Villas) do Dog Bone's quest, bringing him 10 bones.

creator: nocturne
statement: Get the bones by killing the Wood Planks on the platform below.

creator: nocturne
statement: The Obols statue is available here but needs World 2 to unlock.

creator: nocturne
statement: Completing the first boss gives the key to go to World 2.

creator: nocturne
statement: Make sure you are on normal mode when entering the boss.

creator: nocturne
statement: Normal mode boss needs at least 52.5 accuracy to hit him at all (5% chance).

creator: nocturne
statement: You need at least 157.5 accuracy for a 100% hit chance on the boss.

creator: nocturne
statement: Boss Fireball is a random AOE that you must dodge and move around.

creator: nocturne
statement: Rocket Fist is aimed at you and does decent damage but you have time to leave its path.

creator: nocturne
statement: Be careful of the spike trap on the map.

creator: nocturne
statement: Sword swing does a decent amount of damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Stand right at his feet to avoid most of his damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: On a range character you have to be more particular about positioning; you can't just attack him.

creator: nocturne
statement: His stomp shoots rock spikes.

creator: nocturne
statement: Hop into the pit to avoid the stomp rock spikes.

creator: nocturne
statement: He summons totems on the top platform; Healing Totem heals him 1250 periodically while alive.

creator: nocturne
statement: Run up and kill the Healing Totem or DPS through it depending on your damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: He can also summon a Shield Totem which gives the boss a shield.

creator: nocturne
statement: Pay attention to all the abilities first then focus on killing the boss; higher damage kills him quickly.

creator: nocturne
statement: With about 110 defense the boss does no damage to him.

creator: nocturne
statement: Fairly simple fight but can be scary going in.

creator: nocturne
statement: Recommends coming in with multiple keys and spending time learning the fight.

creator: nocturne
statement: Alternatively wait until gear is a bit better to help complete the fight.

creator: nocturne
statement: Dog Bone NPC rewards 1 key per day for each character that has ever given him dog bones.

creator: nocturne
statement: He has 7 characters so gets 7 keys per day.
